jobs.description:
GENERAL SUMMARY

The Director, Commercial and Medical Operations IT Product Manager is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the vision, roadmap, and delivery of technology platforms that enable operational excellence across commercial and medical domains. This role ensures solutions are innovative, scalable, and compliant, supporting the organization’s transformation and growth. This individual will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and I&T teams, ensuring that product strategies align with organizational goals and deliver measurable value. They will lead cross-functional teams, manage product lifecycles, and champion user-centric design and agile methodologies to deliver scalable, high-impact solutions.

This role is accountable not only for technology delivery, but for shaping enterprise-wide business transformation—modernizing operating models, decision-making, and engagement through digital platforms, data, and AI. Success will be measured by measurable improvements in productivity, adoption, compliance, and business outcomes—not output alone.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIP

Reports To: Executive Director, Commercial I&T
Direct Reports: Product Owners, Platform Configuration/Analysts

RESPONSIBILITIES

1) Lead the design and delivery of platforms for revenue management, contracting, pricing, compliance, meetings, training and other operational domains. Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems and compliance with regulatory requirements. Enable decision intelligence across commercial and medical operations by integrating data, analytics, and workflow platforms that support compliant, scalable execution.

2) Develop and communicate a strategic product vision, integrating digital, data, automation and AI capabilities to future-proof operations. Partner with executive stakeholders to identify opportunities for digital transformation and innovation.

3) Act as a platform steward, accountable for long-term architectural integrity, scalability, and cost efficiency—balancing near-term business needs with enterprise standards and future-state evolution.

4) Manage the full end-to-end product lifecycle, prioritizing features based on business impact, user feedback and emerging technology trends.

5) Ensure robust API integration, adherence to interoperability standards, and implementation of data governance practices to deliver scalable, secure, and compliant solutions.

6) Serve as the primary liaison between business units and IT, translating requirements into actionable, secure, and compliant solutions.
Serve as a senior technology leader embedded with the business units, IT functions, anticipating needs and turning requirements into actionable, secure, and compliant digital products.

7) Own the responsible evaluation, adoption, and scaling of AI and advanced analytics capabilities—partnering with Data, Security, Legal, and business leadership to operationalize AI in compliant, high‑value use cases.

8) Develop and manage strategic relationships with external technology and managed services partners to ensure seamless integration, compliance, and innovation across platforms

9) Own product financials including vendor strategy, run vs. grow investment decisions, total cost of ownership, and value realization tracking in partnership with Finance and Procurement.

10) Build and develop agile, cross-functional teams, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning

11) Define and evolve delivery models (product-aligned teams, DevOps, vendor/partner orchestration) to improve speed, quality, and accountability across global teams.

12) Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product performance, business impact, and regulatory compliance.

13) Ensure platforms meet global regulatory, privacy, and cybersecurity standards.

14) Stay ahead of industry trends, regulatory changes, technology innovations, proactively adapting strategies.

Permettre l'intelligence de décision dans les opérations commerciales et médicales en intégrant les données, les analyses et les plates-formes de workflow qui supportent l'exécution conforme et évolutive. - Développer et communiquer une vision stratégique du produit, intégrant les capacités numériques, de données, d'automatisation et d'IA aux opérations à l'épreuve de l'avenir. Établir des partenariats avec les intervenants exécutifs pour cerner les possibilités de transformation et d'innovation numériques. - Agir en tant qu'intendant de plate-forme, responsable de l'intégrité architecturale à long terme, de l'évolutivité et de la rentabilité, en conciliant les besoins à court terme des entreprises avec les normes d'entreprise et l'évolution de l'état futur. - Gérer le cycle de vie complet des produits de bout en bout, hiérarchiser les caractéristiques en fonction de l'impact commercial, de la rétroaction des utilisateurs et des nouvelles tendances technologiques. - Assurer une solide intégration des API, le respect des normes d'interopérabilité et la mise en œuvre de pratiques de gouvernance des données pour fournir des solutions évolutives, sûres et conformes. - Servir de liaison principale entre les unités opérationnelles et les TI, transformant les exigences en solutions actionnables, sécurisées et conformes. Servir de leader technologique senior intégré aux unités opérationnelles, les fonctions informatiques, l'anticipation des besoins et la transformation des exigences en des produits numériques actionnables, sécurisés et conformes. - Oui. jobs.description:
The Director, Field Engagement IT Product Manage r is a visionary leader responsible for shaping and executing the strategy for enterprise-scale technology platforms that drive commercial and medical field effectiveness and engagement. This role bridges business and technology, ensuring solutions deliver measurable value, support digital transformation, and remain agile in a rapidly evolving biopharma landscape. Th ey will lead cross-functional teams, manage product lifecycles, and champion user-centric design and agile methodologies to deliver scalable, high-impact solutions.

This role is accountable not only for technology delivery, but for shaping enterprise-wide business transformation— modernizing operating models, decision-making, and engagement through digital platforms, data, and AI. Success will be measured by measurable improvements in productivity, adoption, compliance, and business outcomes—not output alone.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIP

Reports To: Executive Director, Commercial I&T
Direct Reports: Product Owners, Platform Configuration/Analysts

RESPONSIBILITIES

1) Lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of platforms and solutions optimizing field experience and productivity through integrated CRM, engagement data, and analytics capabilities – balancing simplicity, compliance
and effectiveness.

2) Define and communicate a forward-looking product vision and roadmap, leveraging AI, automation, and advanced analytics to unlock new business opportunities. Partner with executive stakeholders to identify opportunities for
digital transformation and innovation.

3) Act as a platform steward, accountable for long-term architectural integrity, scalability, and cost efficiency—balancing near-term business needs with enterprise standards and future-state evolution.

4) Manage the full end-to-end product lifecycle, prioritizing features based on business impact, user feedback and emerging technology trends.

5) Ensure robust API integration, adherence to interoperability standards, and implementation of data governance practices to deliver scalable, secure, and compliant solutions.

6) Serve as a senior technology leader embedded with the business units, IT functions, anticipating needs and turning requirements into actionable, secure, and compliant digital products.

7) Own the responsible evaluation, adoption, and scaling of AI and advanced analytics capabilities—partnering with Data, Security, Legal, and business leadership to operationalize AI in compliant, high‑value use cases.

8) Develop and manage strategic relationships with external technology and managed services partners to ensure seamless integration, compliance, and innovation across platforms

9) Own product financials including vendor strategy, run vs. grow investment decisions, total cost of ownership, and value realization tracking in partnership with Finance and Procurement.

10) Build and mentor high-performing, cross-functional teams, championing agile, DevOps, and user centric design practices

11) Define and evolve delivery models (product-aligned teams, DevOps, vendor/partner orchestration) to improve speed, quality, and accountability across global teams.

12) Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success, business impact, user adoption, and regulatory compliance.

13) Ensure platforms meet global regulatory, privacy, and cybersecurity standards.

14) Stay ahead of industry trends, regulatory changes, technology innovations, proactively adapting strategies.

15) Drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, and change management initiatives.

16) Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, shaping strategic decisions through data-driven insights, tradeoff analysis, and forward-looking recommendations.

Education
• Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

Experience

Rimanere al passo con le tendenze del settore, i cambiamenti normativi, le innovazioni tecnologiche, adattando attivamente le strategie. - Promuovere il miglioramento continuo, l'eccellenza operativa e le iniziative di gestione dei cambiamenti. - jobs.description:
For our CSL Behring Operations / Manufacturing, we are looking for a Head of Manufacturing Engineering and Maintenance

Closing Date for Applications – 17th April 2026

The Head of Manufacturing Engineering & Maintenance is a strategic leader responsible for the reliability and lifecycle management of manufacturing assets. This role oversees Calibration & Metrology Engineering, Manufacturing Maintenance, Reliability Engineering, Production/System Owner Engineering, and Shutdown Planning & Scheduling. Key responsibilities support critical operations, including fractionation, bulk production, and packaging, while ensuring equipment readiness and compliance with regulatory standards in the biopharmaceutical sector. The position also requires strong skills in labour relations to foster collaboration within a unionized workforce.
Role that this position reports to: Engineering & Maintenance Site Head

Job Purpose

• Direct all aspects of manufacturing engineering and maintenance, including technical support, project management, emergency response, on-call, troubleshooting and corrective, preventive/predictive maintenance

• Ensure facilities and equipment are designed, operated and maintained in compliance with cGMP, Health Authorities (i.e. FDA), EHS

• Drives execution of qualification plans, risk analysis, metrology, data integrity and general GMP issues

• Lead the planning, budgeting, execution and commissioning of major capital projects, facility expansions, and technology upgrades

• Champion asset lifecycle management, reliability engineering and implementation

• Oversees sites workshop operations

• Develop, communicate and execute an engineering and maintenance strategy

• Lead transformation initiatives, including digitalization, advanced automation, sustainability and adoption of cutting-edge manufacturing technologies

• Supports the development and implementation of multi-year strategic plans, capital investment roadmaps and operational readiness programs for all global site

• Lead the sites manufacturing engineering and maintenance organization

• Oversee deviation management, investigation of deviations and establishment of corrective and preventive actions plus develop, monitor and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for engineering and maintenance

• Represent the local manufacturing engineering and maintenance function in regulatory inspections, audit readiness

• Champion the use of digital tools and data analytics (e.g., SAP, Trackwise, FMS, Ariba, Power BI, Smart Sheet, Tableau) and implement CSL Operating System, Six Sigma, Lean

• Conducts regular GEMBAS

• Oversee the management of GMP/non-GMP facility systems

• Manage relationships with external service providers, contractors and vendors

• Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain, IT and other departments

• Engage with global and regional leadership

• Lead, mentor and develop a diverse, cross-functional team

• Oversees assigned cost centres, monitors performances and acts on trends

• Develops budgets for OpEx and headcounts

Your Skills and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical) required, a master’s preferred

• Minimum of ten years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, food, or chemical process industry

• At least five years of technical management or leadership experience

• Significant expertise in GMP/non-GMP manufacturing assets related to pharmaceutical production

• Expertise in sterile manufacturing, bulk production and finishing and packaging operations of (bio) pharmaceuticals

• Experience managing union and non-union workforces

• Advanced skills in facility management systems (Trackwise, SAP, FMS, Ariba, DCMS) and digital tools (MS Project, Excel, Power BI, Smart Sheet, Tableau)

• Knowledge of Six Sigma/Lean principles

• Financial acumen in managing multimillion-dollar budgets

• Experience with global health authorities’ inspections, audits and regulatory agencies

jobs.title: Director, Process Development
jobs.description:
For our global Technical Operations Organization, we are currently looking for a

Director, Process Development

The Director of Process Development leads the design, development, and scale-up of bioprocesses for biologics manufacturing. This role provides strategic and technical leadership to ensure robust, scalable, and compliant upstream and downstream processes across the product lifecycle, from early development to commercial production.

Key Responsibilities:

Bioprocess Development Leadership

• Lead development of Albumin downstream (purification) processes​

• Define process strategies to optimize yield, quality, and scalability​

• Establish critical process parameters (CPPs) and critical quality attributes (CQAs)

Scale-Up & Technology Transfer

• Oversee scale-up from lab to pilot and commercial manufacturing​

• Lead technology transfer to manufacturing sites and external partners (CMOs/CDMOs)​

• Ensure process consistency and robustness across scales and sites

Scientific & Technical Strategy

• Provide expertise in biologics production systems (e.g., CHO, microbial systems, viral vectors)​

• Drive innovation and adoption of new bioprocessing technologies​

• Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex process challenges

Regulatory & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with GMP and global regulatory expectations​

• Support regulatory submissions (IND, BLA/MAA) with process development data​

• Act as SME during inspections and audits

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with MS&T, Manufacturing, Analytical Development, Quality, and Regulatory teams​

• Align process strategies with product and portfolio goals

Leadership & Organizational Development

• Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams (scientists, engineers) ​

• Manage budgets, resources, and project priorities ​

• Build a high-performing, innovative team culture

Lifecycle Management & Continuous Improvement

• Support process validation and continued process verification (CPV)​

• Drive process optimization using data analytics and statistical tools (DOE, multivariate analysis)​

• Implement improvements post-commercialization

Your experience

• PhD (preferred) or Master’s in Biotechnology, Biochemical/Chemical Engineering, or related field ​

• 12–18+ years of experience in bioprocess or biologics development ​

• Strong expertise in downstream processing ​

• Proven experience in scale-up, tech transfer, and commercial manufacturing support ​

• Deep understanding of GMP and regulatory frameworks (FDA, EMA) ​

• Demonstrated leadership and team management experience ​

• Understanding plasma process development preferable

Key Skills

• Deep technical expertise in bioprocessing​

• Strategic leadership and decision-making​

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills​

• Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management​

• Innovation and continuous improvement mindset

​
Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Pl

jobs.title: Principal Scientist, CMC Science
jobs.description:
The Principle Scientist, CMC Science is responsible for supporting and executing Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) strategies for pharmaceutical and/or biologic products across clinical development and early commercialization. This role ensures that drug substance and drug product development activities meet regulatory, quality, and business objectives.​

This role works cross-functionally to drive CMC deliverables, manage external partners, and support global regulatory submissions.

Key Responsibilities

CMC Strategy & Execution

• Contribute to the development and implementation of phase-appropriate CMC strategies​

• Support CMC activities for assigned programs from early development through late-stage clinical development

• Identify risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure timelines and quality standards are met

Process & Analytical Development

• Support drug substance and drug product development activities

• Support analytical method development, validation, and specification setting

• Support process characterization, validation, and lifecycle management

Manufacturing & Tech Transfer

• Manage relationships with CDMOs and manufacturing partners

• Support technology transfer and scale-up activities

• Ensure compliance with GMP requirements

Regulatory Support

• Author, review, and contribute to CMC sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA)

• Support interactions with global regulatory authorities, including the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and the European Medicines Agency

• Address regulatory questions and inspection readiness activities

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, and Technical Operations teams

• Provide technical expertise to management team

• Support budget planning and timeline management for CMC activities

Your Profile

• PhD, MSc, or equivalent degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or related scientific discipline.

• Typically 8-10 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology development.​

• Demonstrated experience in CMC development and regulatory submissions.​

• Experience managing external manufacturing partners preferred

• Strong scientific and technical expertise in CMC disciplines​

• Knowledge of global regulatory guidelines (ICH, GMP)​

• Project leadership and stakeholder management​

• Risk assessment and problem-solving skills​

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

jobs.title: Director, Analytical Strategy
jobs.description:
For our global Technical Operations Organization, we are currently looking for a

Director, Analytical Strategy

The Director, Analytical Strategy is a senior scientific and strategic leadership role responsible for designing and overseeing analytical strategies that support drug discovery, development, and regulatory approval. This position ensures robust, compliant, and innovative analytical approaches across preclinical, clinical programs and LCM.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

• Develop and lead the global analytical strategy aligned with program and corporate goals​

• Provide scientific and regulatory guidance for analytical plans across all development phases (discovery → post-marketing)​

• Drive innovation in analytical technologies, platforms, and workflows​

• Represent analytical function in cross-functional governance and decision-making forums

Scientific Oversight

• Oversee development, validation, and implementation of analytical methods (e.g., LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, immunogenicity)​

• Ensure high-quality data generation for PK, PD, biomarker, and immunogenicity studies​

• Review and approve analytical study designs, reports, and regulatory documentation​

• Troubleshoot complex scientific and technical challenges

Regulatory & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with global regulatory guidelines (FDA, EMA, ICH, GLP, GCP)​

• Lead analytical sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA, MAA)​

• Interface with regulatory agencies and respond to health authority queries​

• Maintain inspection readiness and quality standards

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Clinical Pharmacology, DMPK, Toxicology, Biomarkers, and Clinical Operations​

• Support translational strategy and dose selection decisions​

• Manage external CROs, academic collaborators, and technology vendors

Leadership & Management

• Lead and mentor analytical scientists and project leaders​

• Manage budgets, timelines, and resource allocation​

• Build and scale analytical capabilities and infrastructure

Your experience

• PhD in analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or related field (or MSc with extensive experience)

• Typically, 12–15+ years in bioanalysis within biotech, pharma, or CRO environments ​

• Deep expertise in LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, and immunogenicity testing ​

• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements and analytical validation standards ​

• Proven leadership and strategic program experience ​

• Experience supporting regulatory submissions and health authority interactions

Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application.

This position ensures robust, compliant, and innovative analytical approaches across preclinical, clinical programs and LCM. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership
• Develop and lead the global analytical strategy aligned with program and corporate goals​
• Provide scientific and regulatory guidance for analytical plans across all development phases (discovery → post-marketing)​
• Drive innovation in analytical technologies, platforms, and workflows​
• Represent analytical function in cross-functional governance and decision-making forums Scientific Oversight
• Oversee development, validation, and implementation of analytical methods (e.g., LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, immunogenicity)​
• Ensure high-quality data generation for PK, PD, biomarker, and immunogenicity studies​
• Review and approve analytical study designs, reports, and regulatory documentation​
• Troubleshoot complex scientific and technical challenges Regulatory & Compliance
• Ensure compliance with global regulatory guidelines (FDA, EMA, ICH, GLP, GCP)​
• Lead analytical sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA, MAA)​
• Interface with regulatory agencies and respond to health authority queries​
• Maintain inspection readiness and quality standards Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner with Clinical Pharmacology, DMPK, Toxicology, Biomarkers, and Clinical Operations​
• Support translational strategy and dose selection decisions​
• Manage external CROs, academic collaborators, and technology vendors Leadership & Management
• Lead and mentor analytical scientists and project leaders​
• Manage budgets, timelines, and resource allocation​
• Build and scale analytical capabilities and infrastructure Your experience
• PhD in analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, or related field (or MSc with extensive experience)
• Typically, 12–15+ years in bioanalysis within biotech, pharma, or CRO environments ​
• Deep expertise in LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, and immunogenicity testing ​
• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements and analytical validation standards ​
• Proven leadership and strategic program experience ​
• Experience supporting regulatory submissions and health authority interactions Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application. About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. jobs.title: Principal Stat Programmer
jobs.description:
The Principal Statistical Programmer is responsible for providing leadership and hands-on support in the development and maintenance of the CSL statistical programming capabilities which is required to meet regulatory obligations. The individual will work closely with the Associate Director, Director, and Statistical Programmers to build internal programming tools. This individual, working closely with the study team, will be responsible for review and acceptance of contract research organization (CRO) deliverables which are mainly, but not limited to, datasets in submission ready standard format (ADaM), tables, figures, listings and submission packages. This individual will provide expertise in the design, development and quality control process for SAS programs used to access, extract, transform, review, analyze and submit clinical data for all requested analyses. This individual will collaborate with other departments (eg, Biostatistics, Data Management, Regulatory Operations, Medical Writing, ESP teams) to ensure Standard Operating Procedures are followed and the correct study data are used for all requests. This individual will participate in department and cross functional technology development and process improvement initiatives.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Collaborates with the study teams to design data structure and specifications for ad hoc and study deliverables including, but not limited to ADaM datasets, Tables, Figures, Listings and Analysis Submission content. Plans and leads the production and validation efforts for the designed output, this may include oversight of work by CROs.

• Collaborates with study teams to ensure the quality and accuracy – thus submission readiness – of clinical data as required by authorities (i.e. SDTM, ADaM, tables, figures, listings, define.xml). Supports the review of related deliverables when provided by CROs.

• Leads and oversees requested efforts for pooled and exploratory analyses working closely with Statistics TA lead and/or study statisticians as well as with clinical programming team and their collection of legacy data.

• Leads and oversees the in-house specification and delivery of ISS and ISE datasets and associated output (tables, figures and listings) when not provided by CRO.

• Leads and oversees the design and implementation of complex SAS programs for applications designed to analyze and report complex clinical trial data in CDISC ADaM format.

• Leads and oversees the development of global tools that will increase the efficiency and capacity of the Statistical Programming group.

• Works closely with clinical study teams to execute activities to ensure project timelines are met with high quality deliverables.
Additional tasks:
Collaborates with CR&D staff regarding data analysis requests.
Performs additional statistical analyses including but not limited to:

• support responses to regulatory agencies,

• generate integrated summary of safety and efficacy,

• support publications and presentations,

• support planning and reporting of clinical trials via exploratory analyses of available data,

• replicate CRO and CSL statistician analyses for QC

Job Qualifications and Experience Requirements:
Education
• BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related area with relevant experience
• Other degrees and certifications considered if commensurate with related programming experience

Experience
• At least 7 years of experience in either clinical programming and/or statistical programming, within the CRO/pharmaceutical environment using SAS Software.
• In-depth understanding of clinical programming and/or statistical programming processes and standards.
• In-depth understanding of regulatory requirements relevant to statistical programming (e.g. GCP, ICH).
• Extensive experience with statistical programming using the SAS software including development and use of SAS Macros. Strong programming and problem-solving skills.
• Advanced kn

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Il programmatore statistico principale è responsabile di fornire leadership e supporto pratico nello sviluppo e nella manutenzione delle capacità di programmazione statistica CSL che è tenuto a soddisfare gli obblighi normativi. L'individuo lavorerà a stretto contatto con il direttore associato, direttore e programmatori statistici per costruire strumenti di programmazione interni. Questo individuo, lavorando a stretto contatto con il team di studio, sarà responsabile per la revisione e l'accettazione delle organizzazioni di ricerca contrattuale (CRO) che sono principalmente, ma non solo, datasets in presentazione formato standard pronto (ADaM), tabelle, figure, elenchi e pacchetti di presentazione. Questo individuo fornirà competenze nel processo di progettazione, sviluppo e controllo della qualità per i programmi SAS utilizzati per accedere, estrarre, trasformare, rivedere, analizzare e inviare dati clinici per tutte le analisi richieste. Questo individuo collaborerà con altri dipartimenti (ad esempio, Biostatistica, Gestione dei dati, Operazioni regolamentari, Scrittura Medica, ESP team) per garantire che vengano seguite procedure operative standard e i dati di studio corretti vengono utilizzati per tutte le richieste. Questo individuo parteciperà a iniziative di sviluppo tecnologico funzionale e di miglioramento dei processi. Mansioni - Collabora con i team di studio per progettare la struttura e le specifiche dei dati per gli erogabili ad hoc e di studio, inclusi, ma non limitati ai dataset ADaM, Tabelle, Figure, Liste e Analisi contenuti della sottomissione. Piani e conduce gli sforzi di produzione e validazione per la produzione progettata, questo può includere la supervisione del lavoro da parte dei CRO. - Collabora con i team di studio per garantire la qualità e l'accuratezza – quindi la disponibilità di presentazione – dei dati clinici richiesti dalle autorità (ad esempio SDTM, ADaM, tabelle, figure, elenchi, Defini.xml). Supporta la revisione dei relativi consegnabili quando forniti da CROs. - Piombo e supervisione hanno richiesto sforzi per analisi in pool ed esplorative che lavorano a stretto contatto con Statistiche TA lead e/o studi statistici, nonché con il team di programmazione clinica e la loro raccolta di dati legacy. - conduce e supervisiona le specifiche interne e la consegna dei set di dati ISS e ISE e l'output associato (tavoli, cifre e elenchi) quando non è fornito da CRO. - conduce e supervisiona la progettazione e l'implementazione di programmi SAS complessi per applicazioni progettate per analizzare e riportare i dati di prova clinici complessi in formato CDISC ADaM. - conduce e supervisiona lo sviluppo di strumenti globali che aumenteranno l'efficienza e la capacità del gruppo di programmazione statistica. - Lavora a stretto contatto con i team di studio clinici per eseguire attività per garantire che le tempistiche del progetto siano soddisfatte con materiali di alta qualità. Attività supplemento - Collabora con il personale CR&D per quanto riguarda le richieste di analisi dei dati. - Esegui analisi statistiche aggiuntive, comprese ma non limitate a: - risposte di supporto alle agenzie di regolamentazione, - generare sintesi integrata della sicurezza e dell'efficacia, - pubblicazioni di supporto e presentazioni, - pianificazione di supporto e reporting di studi clinici tramite analisi esplorative dei dati disponibili, - replicare analisi statistiche CRO e CSL per QC
• Requisiti Istruzione - BSc in Informatica, Matematica, Statistica o area relativa con esperienza rilevante - Altri gradi Almeno 7 anni di esperienza nella programmazione clinica e/o nella programmazione statistica, all'interno dell'ambiente CRO/farmaceutico utilizzando il software SAS. - No. Comprensione approfondita dei processi e degli standard di programmazione clinica e/o di programmazione statistica. - comprensione approfondita dei requisiti normativi relativi alla programmazione statistica (ad esempio GCP, ICH). - Ampia esperienza con la programmazione statistica utilizzando il software SAS compreso lo sviluppo e l'uso di SAS Macros. Forte capacità di programmazione e risoluzione dei problemi. - Avanzato kn

titleByLocale.de: Manager, Zulassung für regulatorische klinische Studien (CTA)

jobs.description:
Overview:
The Manager, Clinical Trial Authorization (CTA) is responsible for ensuring that CTA activities for assigned clinical studies are planned, governed, and overseen in line with CSL regulatory expectations, quality standards, and development timelines.
Reporting to the Director, Global Regulatory CTA, the role translates global CTA direction into clear, study‑specific regulatory approaches, provides guidance to Study Teams and partners, and acts as the first line CTA point of contact across functions. The position ensures that CTA activities delivered by external partners are appropriately overseen, risks are identified early and managed proactively.
The role maintains a strong focus on quality, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement by monitoring performance, contributing to metrics and dashboards, driving pragmatic process enhancements, and representing CTA internally during audits and inspections, as required. This role reports to the Director, Global Regulator CTA

Responsibilities:
CTA Strategy Implementation & Regulatory CTA Support

• Translate global CTA strategies into study‑level regulatory approaches, ensuring alignment with development priorities and applicable regulatory requirements delivered via outsourced partners.

• Provide CTA guidance and strategic direction to external service providers, Study Teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders within the approved framework.

• Support early risk‑based CTA planning for critical or complex studies, including country approach, sequencing considerations, and identification of regulatory sensitivities.

• Ensure consistent application of regulatory intelligence and evolving requirements across assigned studies.

• Act as the internal CSL CTA interface for assigned clinical studies, providing cross‑functional coordination and governance oversight within the outsourced delivery model.
Oversight of Outsourced CTA Activities

• Act as the primary oversight contact for external partners performing CTA activities.

• Execute defined risk‑based oversight activities in line with established governance, oversight plans and ways of working documents.

• Monitor vendor performance against agreed KPIs, timelines, and quality expectations and contribute to joint improvement initiatives with partners.

Quality, Compliance & Inspection Readiness

• Ensure outsourced CTA activities are conducted in compliance with GCP requirements and internal procedures.

• Support preparation for Health Authority inspections, audits, including participation as the internal reg CTA representative.

• Proactively escalate compliance risks or deviations and propose appropriate mitigation actions.
Process Adherence & Continuous Improvement

• Proactively ensure adherence to CTA processes and working practices supporting the outsourced delivery model.

• Continuously identify process inefficiencies, quality issues, or recurring risks impacting CTA delivery or oversight and drive improvement actions.

• Lead and support implementation of approved process changes, tools, and templates in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.

• Actively contribute to CTA metrics, dashboards, and reporting to strengthen oversight and inform decision‑making.

Qualifications:
Education:

• A degree (BSc/MSc) or equivalent in life science, pharmacy or other health/medical related field
Experience:

• A minimum of 5 years’ experience in managing Clinical Trial Authorizations

• Strong experience with CTA requirements and processes, including EU CTR.

• Experience working with or overseeing external vendors/CROs.

• Extensive and comprehensive knowledge of ICH guidelines/GCP and current medical/scientific/regulatory knowledge incl. inspection expectation
Competencies

• Demonstrated ability to problem solve and use clear judgment in relation to regulatory requirements, interactions with external parties, timelines, and complex clinical studies

• Strong regulatory judgment within defined strategic frameworks

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Panoramica: Il Responsabile dell'Autorizzazione della Sperimentazione Clinica (CTA) è responsabile di garantire che le attività CTA per gli studi clinici assegnati siano pianificate, governate e supervisionate in linea con le aspettative normative, gli standard di qualità e le tempistiche di sviluppo di CSL. Riportando al Direttore, Global Regulatory CTA, il ruolo traduce la direzione globale del CTA in approcci normativi chiari e specifici per lo studio, fornisce indicazioni ai gruppi di studio e ai partner e funge da punto di contatto CTA di prima linea tra le funzioni. La posizione garantisce che le attività CTA fornite da partner esterni siano adeguatamente supervisionate, i rischi siano identificati tempestivamente e gestiti in modo proattivo. Il ruolo mantiene una forte attenzione alla qualità, alla preparazione alle ispezioni e al miglioramento continuo monitorando le prestazioni, contribuendo a parametri e dashboard, promuovendo miglioramenti pragmatici dei processi e rappresentando CTA internamente durante audit e ispezioni, come richiesto. Questo ruolo riporta al Direttore, Regolatore globale CTA Mansioni Implementazione della strategia CTA e supporto normativo CTA - Tradurre le strategie CTA globali in approcci normativi a livello di studio, garantendo l'allineamento con le priorità di sviluppo e i requisiti normativi applicabili forniti tramite partner in outsourcing. - Fornire indicazioni CTA e indicazioni strategiche ai fornitori di servizi esterni, ai gruppi di studio e alle parti interessate interfunzionali all'interno del quadro approvato. - Supportare la pianificazione CTA precoce basata sul rischio per studi critici o complessi, compreso l'approccio per paese, considerazioni sulla sequenzialità e l'identificazione delle sensibilità normative. - Garantire un'applicazione coerente dell'intelligence normativa e dei requisiti in evoluzione negli studi assegnati. - Agire come interfaccia interna CSL CTA per gli studi clinici assegnati, fornendo coordinamento interfunzionale e supervisione della governance all'interno del modello di consegna in outsourcing. Supervisione delle attività CTA in outsourcing: fungere da contatto di supervisione principale per i partner esterni che svolgono attività CTA. - Eseguire attività di supervisione definite basate sul rischio in linea con la governance stabilita, i piani di supervisione e le modalità dei documenti di lavoro. - Monitorare le prestazioni dei fornitori rispetto ai KPI concordati, alle tempistiche e alle aspettative di qualità e contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento congiunte con i partner. Qualità, conformità e preparazione alle ispezioni: garantire che le attività CTA in outsourcing siano condotte in conformità con i requisiti GCP e le procedure interne. - Supportare la preparazione per le ispezioni e gli audit dell'Autorità sanitaria, inclusa la partecipazione in qualità di rappresentante interno del CTA. - Aumentare in modo proattivo i rischi o le deviazioni dalla conformità e proporre azioni di mitigazione adeguate. Aderenza ai processi e miglioramento continuo: garantire in modo proattivo l'aderenza ai processi CTA e alle pratiche di lavoro a supporto del modello di consegna in outsourcing. - Identificare continuamente le inefficienze dei processi, i problemi di qualità o i rischi ricorrenti che influiscono sulla consegna o sulla supervisione del CTA e promuovere azioni di miglioramento. - Guidare e supportare l'implementazione di modifiche, strumenti e modelli di processo approvati in collaborazione con le parti interessate pertinenti. - Contribuire attivamente alle metriche, ai dashboard e ai report CTA per rafforzare la supervisione e informare il processo decisionale.
• Requisiti Formazione: - Laurea (BSc/MSc) o titolo equivalente in scienze della vita, farmacia o altro settore sanitario/medico. Esperienza: - Un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle autorizzazioni per sperimentazioni cliniche - Forte esperienza con i requisiti e i processi CTA, incluso il CTR UE. - Esperienza di lavoro con o nella supervisione di fornitori/CRO esterni. - Conoscenza ampia e completa delle linee guida ICH/GCP e delle attuali conoscenze medico/scientifiche/normative incl. aspettative di ispezione Competenze - Dimostrata capacità di risolvere problemi e di usare un chiaro giudizio in relazione ai requisiti normativi, alle interazioni con parti esterne, alle tempistiche e agli studi clinici complessi - Forte giudizio normativo all'interno di quadri strategici definiti

Relevant du directeur de la réglementation mondiale du CTA, le rôle traduit l'orientation mondiale du CTA en approches réglementaires claires et spécifiques aux études, fournit des conseils aux équipes d'étude et aux partenaires, et agit en tant que point de contact de première ligne du CTA dans toutes les fonctions. Le poste garantit que les activités du CTA réalisées par des partenaires externes sont correctement supervisées, que les risques sont identifiés dès le début et gérés de manière proactive. Le rôle reste fortement axé sur la qualité, la préparation aux inspections et l'amélioration continue en surveillant les performances, en contribuant aux mesures et aux tableaux de bord, en conduisant des améliorations pragmatiques des processus et en représentant le CTA en interne lors des audits et des inspections, selon les besoins. Ce rôle relève du directeur du régulateur mondial CTA Mansioni Mise en œuvre de la stratégie CTA et soutien réglementaire du CTA - Traduire les stratégies mondiales du CTA en approches réglementaires au niveau des études, en garantissant l'alignement avec les priorités de développement et les exigences réglementaires applicables fournies par l'intermédiaire de partenaires externalisés. - Fournir des conseils et une orientation stratégique du CTA aux prestataires de services externes, aux équipes d'étude et aux parties prenantes interfonctionnelles dans le cadre approuvé. - Soutenir la planification précoce du CTA basée sur les risques pour les études critiques ou complexes, y compris l'approche nationale, les considérations de séquençage et l'identification des sensibilités réglementaires. - Assurer une application cohérente des renseignements réglementaires et des exigences changeantes dans les études assignées. - Agir en tant qu'interface interne du CSL CTA pour les études cliniques assignées, en assurant la coordination interfonctionnelle et la supervision de la gouvernance au sein du modèle de prestation externalisé. Supervision des activités externalisées du CTA - Agir en tant que principal contact de surveillance pour les partenaires externes effectuant des activités du CTA. - Exécuter des activités de surveillance définies basées sur les risques, conformément à la gouvernance établie, aux plans de surveillance et aux méthodes de travail. - Surveiller les performances des fournisseurs par rapport aux KPI, aux délais et aux attentes en matière de qualité convenus et contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration conjointes avec les partenaires. Qualité, conformité et préparation à l'inspection - Veiller à ce que les activités externalisées du CTA soient menées conformément aux exigences et aux procédures internes de GCP. - Soutenir la préparation des inspections et des audits des autorités sanitaires, y compris la participation en tant que représentant interne du reg CTA. - Faire remonter de manière proactive les risques ou les écarts de conformité et proposer des mesures d'atténuation appropriées. Adhésion aux processus et amélioration continue - Assurer de manière proactive le respect des processus et des pratiques de travail du CTA soutenant le modèle de livraison externalisé. - Identifier en permanence les inefficacités des processus, les problèmes de qualité ou les risques récurrents ayant un impact sur la livraison ou la surveillance du CTA et conduire des actions d'amélioration. - Diriger et soutenir la mise en œuvre des changements de processus, des outils et des modèles approuvés en collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées. - Contribuer activement aux mesures, aux tableaux de bord et aux rapports du CTA pour renforcer la surveillance et éclairer la prise de décision. Formation requise : - Un diplôme (BSc/MSc) ou équivalent en sciences de la vie, en pharmacie ou dans un autre domaine lié à la santé/médical. Expérience : - Un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des autorisations d'essais cliniques. - Forte expérience des exigences et des processus du CTA, y compris le CTR de l'UE. - Expérience de travail avec ou de supervision de fournisseurs/CRO externes. - Connaissance approfondie et complète des lignes directrices ICH/BPC et des connaissances médicales/scientifiques/réglementaires actuelles, y compris. attentes en matière d'inspection Compétences - Capacité démontrée à résoudre des problèmes et à faire preuve d'un jugement clair en ce qui concerne les exigences réglementaires, les interactions avec des parties externes, les délais et les études cliniques complexes - Jugement réglementaire fort dans des cadres stratégiques définis

jobs.description:
Position Purpose

The Enterprise Implementation Lead – Horizon 2 is a senior Technical Operations leadership role accountable for the enterprise-wide technical implementation and validation of the Horizon 2 program. The Horizon 2 program included a patented, yield enhancing manufacturing technology that enables significantly higher immunoglobulin production from the same base amount of plasma. Operating within the Horizon 2 program organization, the role serves as the primary enterprise integrator across Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M), and enabling capital projects, ensuring technical intent, process maturity, validation outcomes, program learnings, and regulatory-facing technical content are coherently translated into effective and sustainable execution at scale.

Role Responsibilities

Horizon 2 Program Technical Accountabilities
The Enterprise Implementation Lead is accountable for the end-to-end technical delivery of the Horizon 2 program across development, process implementation, technology transfer, validation, and the creation of development and technical content required to support global regulatory filings. This includes translating development outputs into scalable, compliant manufacturing solutions and ensuring that process knowledge, control strategies, validation evidence, and regulatory-facing technical narratives are robustly established to enable successful submissions and ongoing deployment as well as new expansion across the CSL network.

• Lead and integrate technical development activities through to process implementation, ensuring continuity of technical intent and readiness for manufacturing scale-up

• Define and execute enterprise process implementation strategies that convert development learnings into site-ready, executable solutions across new and existing facilities

• Own and coordinate Tech Ops accountabilities for technology transfer, including definition of transfer strategies, critical process parameters, and success criteria across sites

• Hold accountability for validation strategy and execution associated with the Horizon 2 program, ensuring validation is risk-based, inspection-ready, and aligned with regulatory expectations

• Own the development and integration of technical and development content required for regulatory submissions, ensuring consistency between development data, validation evidence, and filing narratives

• Ensure alignment between development data, qualification outcomes, validation evidence, and regulatory content to support Manufacturing operational readiness and sustainable GMP production

• Drive Right-First-Time (RFT) delivery through disciplined technical risk management, issue resolution, and data-driven decision-making

Cross-Functional Collaboration, Integration & Governance

• Partner with Manufacturing on Operational Readiness by providing Tech Ops inputs including process knowledge, tech transfer requirements, validation status, and process risk transparency

• Partner with Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) in project delivery to ensure Tech Ops process requirements, parameters, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined and aligned with design, construction, qualification, and asset handover expectations

• Partner closely with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to jointly develop, review, and approve validation strategies, regulatory submission content, and inspection readiness narratives, ensuring alignment between technical execution and regulatory commitments

• Maintain the enterprise-level technical, validation, and regulatory risk register for the Horizon 2 program, with clear ownership and escalation paths

• Serve as the primary technical communication conduit between sites, program leadership, Quality, Regulatory, and governance forums

Team Leadership

• Lead a lean, senior Tech Ops-focused implementation and validation team (direct and matrixed)

• Drive enterprise learning, reuse, and continuous improvement acros

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggetto L'Enterprise Implementation Lead – Horizon 2 è un ruolo di leadership senior Technical Operations responsabile per l'implementazione e la validazione tecnica a livello aziendale del programma Horizon 2. Il programma Horizon 2 includeva una tecnologia brevettata, che migliora la resa di produzione che consente una produzione di immunoglobulina significativamente superiore dalla stessa quantità di base del plasma. Operando all'interno dell'organizzazione del programma Horizon 2, il ruolo serve come integratore primario di impresa in Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M), e consentendo progetti di capitale, garantendo l'intento tecnico, la maturità di processo, i risultati di validazione, gli apprendisti di programma e i contenuti tecnici conformi alle normative sono tradotti coerentemente in esecuzione efficace e sostenibile in scala. Responsabilità del ruolo Horizon 2 Programma Capacità tecniche L'Enterprise Implementation Lead è responsabile per la consegna tecnica end-to-end del programma Horizon 2 attraverso lo sviluppo, l'implementazione del processo, il trasferimento tecnologico, la validazione e la creazione di sviluppo e contenuti tecnici necessari per supportare i processi normativi globali. Ciò include la traduzione di output di sviluppo in soluzioni di produzione scalabili e conformi e garantire che le conoscenze di processo, le strategie di controllo, le prove di validazione e le narrazioni tecniche conformi alle normative siano saldamente stabilite per consentire presentazioni di successo e la distribuzione in corso, nonché la nuova espansione attraverso la rete CSL.
• Guidare e integrare le attività di sviluppo tecnico attraverso l'implementazione del processo, garantendo continuità dell'intento tecnico e della prontezza per la produzione
• Definire ed eseguire strategie di implementazione di processi aziendali che convertono gli apprendimento di sviluppo in soluzioni pronte al sito, eseguibili in strutture nuove e esistenti
• Possedere e coordinare le responsabilità Tech Ops per il trasferimento di tecnologia, compresa la definizione di strategie di trasferimento, parametri di processo critici e criteri di successo in tutti i siti
• Tenere la responsabilità della strategia di validazione e dell'esecuzione associata al programma Horizon 2, assicurando che la validazione sia basata sul rischio, pronta all'ispezione e allineata alle aspettative normative
• Possedere allo sviluppo e all'integrazione dei contenuti tecnici e di sviluppo necessari per le presentazioni normative, assicurando la coerenza tra i dati di sviluppo, le prove di validazione e le narrazioni di archiviazione
• Assicurare l'allineamento tra i dati di sviluppo, i risultati delle qualifiche, le prove di validazione e i contenuti normativi per supportare la prontezza operativa e la produzione GMP sostenibile
• Drive Right-First-Time (RFT) consegna attraverso la gestione del rischio tecnico disciplinato, risoluzione dei problemi e processo decisionale basato sui dati Collaborazione, integrazione e governance
• Partner con Manufacturing on Operational Readiness fornendo ingressi Tech Ops tra cui conoscenze di processo, requisiti di trasferimento tecnico, stato di validazione e trasparenza del rischio di processo
• Partner con Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) nella fornitura di progetti per garantire che i requisiti di processo, i parametri e i criteri di accettazione di Tech Ops siano chiaramente definiti e allineati con le aspettative di progettazione, costruzione, qualificazione e erogazione di asset
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli Affari di Qualità e Regolazione per sviluppare, rivedere e approvare strategie di validazione, contenuti di presentazione normativi e narrazioni di prontezza di ispezione, garantendo l'allineamento tra esecuzione tecnica e impegni normativi
• Mantenere il registro di rischio tecnico, convalida e regolamentare a livello aziendale per il programma Horizon 2, con percorsi di chiara proprietà e di escalation
• Servire come principale canale di comunicazione tecnica tra siti, leadership di programma, forum di qualità, regolamentazione e governance Leadership del team
• Lead a magra, senior Tech Ops focalizzato implementazione e validazione team (diretto e matrice)
• Acro di apprendimento, riutilizzo e miglioramento continuo

descriptionByLocale.de:
Aufgabenstellung Die Enterprise Implementation Lead – Horizon 2 ist eine leitende Führungsrolle für die unternehmensweite technische Umsetzung und Validierung des Horizon 2 Programms. Das Horizon 2 Programm beinhaltete eine patentierte, leistungssteigernde Fertigungstechnologie, die eine deutlich höhere Immunglobulinproduktion aus der gleichen Basismenge Plasma ermöglicht. Im Rahmen der Horizon 2 Programmorganisation fungiert die Rolle als primärer Unternehmensintegrator über Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) und ermöglicht Kapitalprojekte, die sicherstellen, dass technische Absichten, Prozessreife, Validierungsergebnisse, Programmerwerbe und regulatorisch ausgerichtete technische Inhalte kohärent in effektive und nachhaltige Ausführung im Maßstab übersetzt werden. Aufgaben Horizon 2 Programm Technische Rechenschaften Die Enterprise Implementation Lead ist verantwortlich für die technische End-to-End-Lieferung des Horizon 2 Programms über Entwicklung, Prozessumsetzung, Technologietransfer, Validierung und die Erstellung von Entwicklungs- und technischen Inhalten, die zur Unterstützung globaler regulatorischer Einreichungen erforderlich sind. Dazu gehören die Übersetzung von Entwicklungsausgängen in skalierbare, konforme Fertigungslösungen und die Sicherstellung, dass Prozesswissen, Steuerungsstrategien, Validierungsnachweise und regulatorisch ausgerichtete technische Erzählungen robust etabliert sind, um erfolgreiche Einreichungen und laufende Bereitstellung sowie neue Erweiterungen im gesamten CSL-Netzwerk zu ermöglichen.
• Führen und integrieren Sie technische Entwicklungsaktivitäten durch die Prozessdurchführung, Sicherstellung der Kontinuität der technischen Absicht und der Bereitschaft zur Herstellung von Scale-up
• Festlegung und Durchführung von Strategien zur Umsetzung von Strategien zur Umsetzung von Entwicklungslern in standortbereite, ausführbare Lösungen in neuen und bestehenden Einrichtungen
• Eigene und koordinierende Rechenschaftspflichten für den Technologietransfer, einschließlich Definition von Transferstrategien, kritischen Prozessparametern und Erfolgskriterien an Standorten
• Halten Sie die Rechenschaftspflicht für Validierungsstrategie und Durchführung im Zusammenhang mit dem Horizon 2 Programm, um sicherzustellen, dass die Validierung risikobasiert, inspiziert und mit regulatorischen Erwartungen ausgerichtet ist
• Eigene Entwicklung und Integration von technischen und entwicklungsbezogenen Inhalten, die für regulatorische Einreichungen erforderlich sind, um die Konsistenz zwischen Entwicklungsdaten, Validierungsnachweisen und Anmelden zu gewährleisten
• Sicherstellung der Angleichung zwischen Entwicklungsdaten, Qualifikationsergebnissen, Validierungsnachweisen und regulatorischen Inhalten zur Unterstützung der betrieblichen Bereitschaft der Fertigung und der nachhaltigen GMP-Produktion
• Führen Sie die Lieferung von Recht-Erst-Zeit (RFT) durch diszipliniertes technisches Risikomanagement, Problemlösung und datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung Cross-Functional Collaboration, Integration & Governance
• Partner bei der Herstellung von Betriebsbereitschaft durch die Bereitstellung von Tech Ops-Inputs, einschließlich Prozesswissen, Technologietransferanforderungen, Validierungsstatus und Prozessrisikotransparenz
• Partner mit Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) in der Projektauslieferung, um sicherzustellen, dass die Prozessanforderungen, Parameter und Akzeptanzkriterien von Tech Ops klar definiert und mit den Erwartungen von Design, Konstruktion, Qualifizierung und Vermögensübernahme abgestimmt werden
• Partner eng mit Quality and Regulatory Affairs zusammenarbeiten, um gemeinsam Validierungsstrategien, regulatorische Einreichungsinhalte und Inspektionsbereitschafts-Erzählungen zu entwickeln, zu überprüfen und zu genehmigen, um eine Angleichung zwischen technischer Ausführung und regulatorischen Verpflichtungen sicherzustellen
• Pflege des technischen, Validierungs- und regulatorischen Risikoregisters für das Horizon 2 Programm mit klaren Eigentums- und Eskalationswegen
• Als primäre technische Kommunikationsleitung zwischen Standorten, Programmleitung, Qualität, Regulierung und Governance-Foren dienen Teamleiter
• Führen Sie ein schlankes, Senior Tech Ops-fokussiertes Implementierungs- und Validierungsteam (direkt und matrixförmig)
• Unternehmen lernen, wiederverwenden und kontinuierliche Verbesserung Akros
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Fonction Le responsable de la mise en oeuvre de l'entreprise – Horizon 2 est un chef de file principal des opérations techniques responsable de la mise en oeuvre et de la validation techniques à l'échelle de l'entreprise du programme Horizon 2. Le programme Horizon 2 comprenait une technologie de fabrication brevetée qui améliore le rendement et permet une production d'immunoglobuline significativement plus élevée à partir de la même quantité de plasma de base. Fonctionnant au sein de l'organisation du programme Horizon 2, ce rôle est l'intégrateur principal de l'entreprise dans les opérations techniques, la fabrication, la qualité, l'ingénierie et la maintenance (E&M), et permet des projets d'immobilisations, assurant l'intention technique, la maturité du processus, les résultats de validation, les apprentissages du programme et le contenu technique axé sur la réglementation sont traduits de façon cohérente en une exécution efficace et durable à l'échelle. Rôle Responsabilités Responsabilités techniques du programme Horizon 2 Le responsable de la mise en oeuvre de l'entreprise est responsable de la prestation technique de bout en bout du programme Horizon 2 au cours de l'élaboration, de la mise en oeuvre des processus, du transfert de technologie, de la validation et de la création du développement et du contenu technique requis pour appuyer les dépôts réglementaires mondiaux. Il s'agit notamment de traduire les extrants de développement en solutions de fabrication évolutives et conformes et de s'assurer que les connaissances sur les processus, les stratégies de contrôle, les preuves de validation et les descriptions techniques axées sur la réglementation sont solidement établies pour permettre la réussite des soumissions et le déploiement continu ainsi que l'expansion du réseau de LSC.
• Diriger et intégrer les activités de développement technique par le biais de la mise en œuvre des processus, en assurant la continuité de l'intention technique et la préparation à l'expansion de la fabrication
• Définir et exécuter des stratégies de mise en œuvre des processus d'entreprise qui convertissent les apprentissages de développement en solutions exécutables prêtes à être mises en place dans les installations nouvelles et existantes
• Posséder et coordonner des responsabilités en matière de transfert de technologie, y compris la définition de stratégies de transfert, de paramètres de processus critiques et de critères de succès pour tous les sites
• Tenir compte de la stratégie de validation et de l'exécution du programme Horizon 2, en veillant à ce que la validation soit axée sur les risques, prête à l'inspection et conforme aux attentes réglementaires
• S'approprier l'élaboration et l'intégration du contenu technique et du contenu de développement requis pour les présentations réglementaires, en assurant la cohérence entre les données de développement, les preuves de validation et les textes explicatifs de classement
• Assurer l'alignement entre les données de développement, les résultats de qualification, les preuves de validation et le contenu réglementaire pour soutenir la préparation opérationnelle de la fabrication et la production durable de BPF
• Diriger la prestation du droit pour la première fois grâce à une gestion des risques techniques disciplinée, à la résolution des problèmes et à la prise de décisions axées sur les données Collaboration interfonctionnelle, intégration et gouvernance
• Partenaire avec Manufacturing on Operational Ready en fournissant des intrants Tech Ops comprenant des connaissances sur les processus, les exigences de transfert de technologie, l'état de validation et la transparence des risques liés aux processus
• S'associer à l'ingénierie et à la maintenance (E&M) pour assurer que les exigences, les paramètres et les critères d'acceptation des opérations techniques soient clairement définis et alignés sur les attentes en matière de conception, de construction, de qualification et de transfert d'actifs
• Collaborer étroitement avec Qualité et Affaires réglementaires pour élaborer, examiner et approuver conjointement les stratégies de validation, le contenu des présentations réglementaires et les textes explicatifs sur la préparation à l'inspection, en assurant l'alignement entre l'exécution technique et les engagements réglementaires
• Tenir à jour le registre des risques techniques, de validation et réglementaires au niveau de l'entreprise pour le programme Horizon 2, avec des voies claires de propriété et d'escalade
• Servir de canal de communication technique principal entre les sites, le leadership du programme, la qualité, la réglementation et les forums de gouvernance Leadership d'équipe
• Diriger une équipe de mise en œuvre et de validation axée sur les opérations techniques (directe et matricielle)
• Favoriser l'apprentissage, la réutilisation et l'amélioration continue des entreprises

jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Senior Director Search & Evaluation Late TA Lead, Immunology? The job is in our Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Switzerland or Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Position Description Summary ​

Senior Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of later-stage external Hematology therapeutic area. You will focus on opportunities from Phase 2 through marketed drugs, requiring deep clinical expertise, strong engagement with external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical investigators, and a keen understanding of evolving standards of care. The role is critical to shaping our portfolio through high-impact partnerships and transactions. ​

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and integrating late-stage external innovation priorities into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing efforts for Phase 2 to marketed assets, identifying opportunities that align with TA strategy and unmet medical needs. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Early Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Engage extensively with external KOLs, clinical investigators, and networks to validate asset potential, understand trial designs & clinical endpoints, and anticipate competitive dynamics. ​

• Maintain deep awareness of changing standards of care and competitive landscapes to inform sourcing priorities and deal strategy. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for late-stage assets, coordinating clinical, regulatory, commercial, and market access assessments to support governance decisions. ​

• Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and building relationships with pharma, biotech, and clinical communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• 15+ years in biopharma with significant experience in clinical development, external innovation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (MD, PhD, or equivalent). ​

• Deep clinical expertise in Immunology, Hematology, or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of sourcing and closing late-stage deals and engaging with KOLs and clinical networks. ​

• Strong understanding of regulatory pathways, market access, and competitive standards of care. ​

The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $263,000 - $328,000. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximum base pay that CSL expects to pay for this position at the listed for Waltham MA at the time of this posting. Individual base salary for a successful candidate is determined by qualifications, skill level, experience, competencies and other relevant factors. In addition to base salary, total compensation for this role may also include incentive compensation and equity.

L'organizzazione di ricerca e sviluppo di CSL sta accelerando l'innovazione per offrire un maggiore impatto ai pazienti. Con una struttura guidata da progetti e un focus sulla collaborazione, stiamo costruendo un team pronto per il futuro che prospera in ecosistemi biotecnologici dinamici. Unirsi ora a CSL significa far parte di un team agile impegnato a sviluppare terapie che facciano una differenza significativa in tutto il mondo. Potresti essere il nostro prossimo Direttore senior Ricerca e valutazione Responsabile AT tardivo, Immunologia? Il lavoro è nel nostro ufficio di Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Svizzera o Maidenhead nel Regno Unito. Questa è una posizione ibrida ed è in sede tre giorni alla settimana. Descrizione della posizione Riepilogo Direttori senior di ricerca e valutazione per guidare l'approvvigionamento strategico e la valutazione dell'area terapeutica esterna di ematologia in fase avanzata. Ti concentrerai sulle opportunità dalla Fase 2 ai farmaci commercializzati, che richiedono una profonda esperienza clinica, un forte coinvolgimento con Key Opinion Leader (KOL) esterni e investigatori clinici e una profonda comprensione degli standard di cura in evoluzione. Il ruolo è fondamentale per modellare il nostro portafoglio attraverso partnership e transazioni ad alto impatto. ​ Principali responsabilità e responsabilità ​
• Servire come leader S&E senior all'interno del TALT, influenzando la strategia terapeutica e integrando le priorità di innovazione esterna in fase avanzata nella pianificazione del portafoglio. ​
• Guidare gli sforzi proattivi di approvvigionamento per la Fase 2 delle risorse commercializzate, identificando opportunità in linea con la strategia AT e le esigenze mediche non soddisfatte. ​
• Co-condurre riunioni interne (con Early Search Lead) incentrate sulla valutazione e sull'assegnazione delle priorità alle opportunità di nuovi prodotti (NPO) all'interno delle aree terapeutiche di ciascun CSL. Le riunioni NPO sono punti di controllo strategici in cui team interfunzionali esaminano le potenziali risorse identificate dalla Ricerca e decidono se promuoverle per ulteriori due diligence e negoziazioni di accordi.
• Coinvolgere ampiamente con KOL esterni, investigatori clinici e reti per convalidare il potenziale delle risorse, comprendere i progetti di sperimentazione e gli endpoint clinici e anticipare le dinamiche competitive. ​
• Mantenere una profonda consapevolezza dei cambiamenti degli standard di cura e del panorama competitivo per informare le priorità di approvvigionamento e la strategia di negoziazione. ​
• Promuovere la due diligence interfunzionale per le risorse in fase avanzata, coordinando le valutazioni cliniche, normative, commerciali e di accesso al mercato per supportare le decisioni di governance. ​
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con BD e i leader dell'ecosistema regionale per promuovere opportunità ad alta priorità attraverso la negoziazione e la conclusione degli accordi, garantendo un passaggio e un'esecuzione senza intoppi. ​
• Rappresentare l'AT all'esterno, guidando attività di sourcing in conferenze specializzate e costruendo rapporti con comunità farmaceutiche, biotecnologiche e cliniche. ​ Qualifiche e requisiti di esperienza ​
• Oltre 15 anni nel settore biofarmaceutico con esperienza significativa nello sviluppo clinico, nell'innovazione esterna o nello sviluppo aziendale. ​
• Laurea avanzata richiesta (medicinale, dottorato di ricerca o equivalente). ​
• Approfondita esperienza clinica nelle aree terapeutiche immunologica, ematologica o cardiovascolare/renale. ​
• Comprovata esperienza nell'approvvigionamento e nella chiusura di accordi in fase avanzata e nel coinvolgimento di KOL e reti cliniche. ​
• Forte conoscenza dei percorsi normativi, dell'accesso al mercato e degli standard di cura competitivi. ​ L'intervallo di stipendio base previsto per questa posizione al momento dell'assunzione è $ 263.000 - $ 328.000. Si prega di notare che questa fascia salariale riflette la retribuzione base minima e massima che CSL prevede di pagare per questa posizione presso l'elenco per Waltham MA al momento di questo annuncio. Lo stipendio base individuale per un candidato prescelto è determinato dalle qualifiche, dal livello di abilità, dall'esperienza, dalle competenze e da altri fattori rilevanti. Jetzt bei CSL einzusteigen bedeutet, Teil eines agilen Teams zu sein, das sich für die Entwicklung von Therapien einsetzt, die weltweit einen bedeutenden Unterschied machen. Rejoindre CSL, c’est désormais faire partie d’une équipe agile engagée à développer des thérapies qui font une différence significative dans le monde entier. Résumé de la description du poste Les directeurs principaux de la recherche et de l'évaluation dirigeront l'approvisionnement stratégique et l'évaluation du domaine thérapeutique externe de l'hématologie à un stade ultérieur. Vous vous concentrerez sur les opportunités de la phase 2 jusqu'aux médicaments commercialisés, nécessitant une expertise clinique approfondie, un engagement fort avec les principaux leaders d'opinion (KOL) externes et les enquêteurs cliniques, ainsi qu'une compréhension approfondie de l'évolution des normes de soins. Ce rôle est essentiel pour façonner notre portefeuille grâce à des partenariats et des transactions à fort impact. ​ Principales responsabilités et responsabilités ​
• Servir de leader senior en S&E au sein du TALT, en influençant la stratégie thérapeutique et en intégrant les priorités d'innovation externe à un stade avancé dans la planification du portefeuille. ​
• Diriger les efforts d'approvisionnement proactifs pour la phase 2 vers les actifs commercialisés, en identifiant les opportunités qui correspondent à la stratégie d'AT et aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits. ​

• Maintenir une connaissance approfondie de l'évolution des normes de soins et des paysages concurrentiels pour éclairer les priorités d'approvisionnement et la stratégie de transaction. ​

• Plus de 15 ans dans le domaine biopharmaceutique avec une expérience significative en développement clinique, en innovation externe ou en développement commercial. ​
• Diplôme d'études supérieures requis (MD, PhD ou équivalent). ​
• Expertise clinique approfondie dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de l'hématologie ou des maladies cardiovasculaires/rénales. ​
• Expérience avérée en matière de recherche et de conclusion d'accords à un stade avancé et d'engagement avec des KOL et des réseaux cliniques. ​
• Solide compréhension des voies réglementaires, de l'accès au marché et des normes de soins compétitives. ​ L'échelle salariale de base attendue pour ce poste au moment de l'embauche est de 263 000 $ à 328 000 $. Veuillez noter que cette échelle salariale reflète le salaire de base minimum et maximum que CSL s'attend à payer pour ce poste chez Waltham MA au moment de cette publication. Le salaire de base individuel d'un candidat retenu est déterminé par ses qualifications, son niveau de compétence, son expérience, ses compétences et d'autres facteurs pertinents. En plus du salaire de base, la rémunération totale pour ce rôle peut également inclure une rémunération incitative et des actions. #LI-HYBRID À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un leader mondial des biothérapeutiques animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Axés sur la satisfaction des besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et proposons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant avec la maladie.
